description: This file defines a struct and functions related to managing placeholder identifiers for internationalization, including generating unique placeholder strings.

classes.name: PlaceholderState
classes.description: A struct that tracks used placeholder strings and generates new unique placeholders.

methods.name: NewPlaceholderState
methods.description: Creates a new PlaceholderState instance, initializing it with used placeholder strings found in the provided text.

methods.name: PlaceholderState.Next
methods.description: Generates and returns a new unique placeholder string that has not been used before.
